meta.name: track-management
meta.description: Use this skill when creating, managing, or working with Conductor tracks - the logical work units for features, bugs, and refactors. Applies to spec.md, plan.md, and track lifecycle operations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理功能、缺陷和重构的开发工作单元与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果开发时需要把功能、缺陷和重构整理成有文档的工作单元
copy.tagline_en: Organize features, bugs, and refactors into trackable work units
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to break dev work into tracked units with specs and plans

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会遵循 Conductor 轨道的生命周期规范：创建、管理并完成功能/缺陷/重构等工作单元，编写或审查 spec.md 与 plan.md，记录任务状态、提交 SHA，并更新 tracks.md 注册表。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、管理或处理 Conductor 轨道（功能、缺陷、重构等），或涉及 spec.md、plan.md 及轨道生命周期操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新功能轨道：用户登录支持指纹识别。
say.note: Claude 会创建轨道并更新 tracks.md。

say.text: 为这个缺陷写 spec.md 和 plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会生成规格与计划文件。

say.text: 把 plan.md 里第一个任务标记为完成，并记录 SHA。
say.note: Claude 会更新任务状态和提交哈希。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude follows Conductor track lifecycle conventions: it creates, manages, and completes work units for features/bugs/refactors, writes or reviews spec.md and plan.md, records task status and commit SHAs, and updates the tracks.md registry.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create, manage, or work on Conductor tracks (features, bugs, refactors, etc.), or when dealing with spec.md, plan.md, or track lifecycle operations.

say_en.text: Create a new feature track: support fingerprint login.
say_en.note: Claude will create the track and update tracks.md.

say_en.text: Write spec.md and plan.md for this bug.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the spec and plan files.

say_en.text: Mark the first task in plan.md as done and record the SHA.
say_en.note: Claude will update task status and commit hash.
